notes: Checked against MDN's Attribution and copyright licensing page (the same grant is in the mdn/content repository's LICENSE.md: prose CC BY-SA 2.5, code examples CC0 from 2010-08-20, MIT before that). CC BY-SA 2.5 allows commercial use, so this would be a show entry, but it is set aside because the site's terms of use (the Mozilla Websites terms, linked from MDN's footer at www.mozilla.org) were not read: that host wasn't reachable, so it's unconfirmed that nothing there limits automated or commercial use. Also, MDN says its prose is CC BY-SA 2.5 "unless otherwise indicated" and some pages carry another licence, the licence of pre-2010 code can't now be told per sample (the page says so), and the logos and look and feel aren't licensed. Reading www.mozilla.org/about/legal/terms/mozilla and confirming no clause undercuts the licence would let it move to entries. Credit: title, link to the page, "Mozilla Contributors" and CC BY-SA 2.5; changes must be indicated, and changed text stays under CC BY-SA. MDN's page says linking to it is allowed. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
